contentEn:
Today we launch MentivisOS Open: the free, permanent, open-to-everyone version of our native AI learning OS.

No trial period. No credit card. No crippled features designed to push an upgrade. Open is free forever, for everyone, unconditionally.

## Why a free version

For two years we have been building MentivisOS for training organizations, companies and schools. We learned one simple thing working with them: the quality of instructional design should not be a privilege reserved for organizations that can afford an enterprise LMS.

A professional changing careers who wants to structure their learning deserves the same level of tooling as a large company managing a thousand learners. A student figuring out their path deserves a real diagnostic, not a shuffled list of videos. A 60-year-old who wants to understand artificial intelligence deserves a path that adapts to their actual level, not a catalogue to browse alone.

MentivisOS Open exists for that.

## What it is, concretely

MentivisOS Open is not a course platform. There is no pre-packaged content catalogue, no videos to consume in sequence, no certificate purchased at the end of a module tunnel.

It is a learning OS. The difference is structural.

A learning OS works upstream of content. It starts from what you want to reach, assesses where you actually are, identifies the gaps between the two, and builds an ordered path to close them. Content comes after, in the right place, at the right time, at the right level.

Concretely, MentivisOS Open works in six steps.

**Define.** Start with the target competencies: a job, a domain, a precise objective. The OS works from competency frameworks, not topic lists.

**Generate.** A personalized learning path is built automatically, with clear objectives and modules sequenced according to the most effective progression logic for the profile and starting level.

**Learn.** AI agents accompany each learner throughout the path. They explain, rephrase, answer questions, adapt the pace. Not a generic chatbot: a pedagogical companion focused on the defined objective.

**Assess.** Quizzes and practical scenarios validate knowledge at each stage. Assessment is not a formality at the end of the path: it is part of the learning process itself.

**Certify.** At the end of the path, a certified competency badge is issued. Traceable, shareable, grounded in competencies actually validated.

**Analyze.** A personal dashboard tracks progress, visualizes acquired skills and identifies what still needs work.

## Who it is for

MentivisOS Open is not designed for a specific profile. That is precisely what sets it apart.

A high school student exploring several fields before choosing a direction. A professional who wants to build skills on a specific topic without depending on their employer's training plan. A freelancer or independent who wants to structure their expertise in a traceable way. A trainer who wants to test a pedagogical architecture before deploying it in a professional version. Someone in career transition who would rather build their own path than pay several thousand euros for a packaged training program. Someone simply curious, with no professional objective, who wants to learn something seriously.

No required level. No prerequisites. Ready in thirty seconds.

## What Open is not

MentivisOS Open does not replace LearningOS or TalentOS, our professional solutions for organizations. It is not designed to manage learner cohorts, produce OPCO reporting, handle compliance, or run a company training plan.

Open is an individual version. It is built for one person learning, not for an organization training.

For training organizations, companies and schools, LearningOS and TalentOS remain the right answers. Open is the entry point for everyone else.

## Free forever. What that means

We do not believe in the freemium model that gates essential features to force an upgrade. We do not believe in the free version as a disguised acquisition funnel either.

Open is free because we think access to structured, serious learning is a matter of principle, not pricing.

This model is made possible by the revenue generated by our professional solutions. Open lives because of LearningOS and TalentOS. In return, Open allows us to test, learn and continuously improve what we build for our professional clients.

It is a balance that works for us.

**MentivisOS Open is available now.**

Learn whatever you want. Free forever.
